annotation_requirement: All78 first-day1fps nativeframes annotated independently from model predictions; negative frames retained; review+source/pixel hashes frozen before training.
checkpoint_selection: Ultralytics best.pt according to built-in class-averaged validation mAP50-95 fitness; fixed two whole clips only. Retain last.pt and all epoch metrics. No threshold search.

crop_policy.association: Each torso must have >=90% of its area within exactly one whole-animal prediction, and that whole prediction must have exactly one such torso. Otherwise abstain. Assign whole-animal trackID to torso evidence. Never associate via identity label or query truth.
crop_policy.geometry: Apply existing min64px, no-border, overlap<=.2 eligibility to torso rectangles; whole box may touch image boundary. Track/display/IoU metric retain original whole-visible-animal rectangle.
crop_policy.model: Unadapted official MIEWid FP32, existing input transform; no new embedding training

enrollment: Fresh June8 predicted torso crops only, manually confirm correct animal and usable coat; at most10 references/cow via existing deterministic medoid then farthest-point selection. Count proposed/rejected/confirmed photos, retain missing cows in intended-known denominator. Never train identity from filename.

initial_model.source: Ultralytics official COCO-pretrained YOLO11s; cached public weights

labels.coat_torso: Clearly visible coat-bearing trunk from shoulder/chest to rump, excluding head, neck, legs and tail; tight visible extent only. No box if torso is absent, unclear or tiny.
labels.identities: Principal passage known ID may aid independent annotation; all detection labels discard identity. Any identified withheld cow causes frame exclusion. Unknown nuisance fragments cannot certify biological identity and are recorded as such.
labels.whole_visible_cow: All visible animal extent clipped to source image, including small/uncertain fragments if actually visible; do not infer hidden extent. Uncertainty is retained in annotation.

limitations: Only53training and25validation correlated first-day frames; small camera-specific feasibility trial, not general-purpose cattle detector.
Possible unknown nuisance fragments cannot be physically identified from publisher principal labels alone; no claim of identity-pure localization-training negatives.
Seven intended-known and two principal unknown return passages cannot establish population99%precision/1%falseaccept reliability.
purpose: June8-only camera-specific localization and coat crop adaptation; June9 is already exposed regression, not a new blind test
query: After training/gallery/policy freeze, rerun exact existing105 June9 scoring frames with all intermediate5fps frames. Unchanged independent whole-visible truth and conservative metric; report as exposed regression. No post-query model/threshold selection.
split_rule: Sort seven opaque clip IDs by SHA256(purdue-june8-localization-v1:<clip>); first two validation, remaining five training. Frozen before first-day annotation results or adapted-model scores.
